prompt: A team wrote this triage plan. One step misuses milestones. Click the offending line.
explanation: Milestones are dated goals, not buckets for all incoming work — parking everything in a "Backlog" milestone makes progress meaningless. New issues stay unlabeled-by-milestone; a project view or label serves as the backlog.
codeLines: Create a "triage" label to classify incoming issues
Create milestone "Sprint 42" with a due date
Assign every new issue to milestone "Backlog"
Add the sprint issues to the Sprint 42 board view
